characterV1: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a production game battle sprite atlas based on the referenced Mordrane corrupted dragon knight illustration, preserving his horned closed black helmet, black layered steel armor with sharp antique bone-gold trim, glowing red chest core, enormous straight black greatsword with glowing red fissure, two ragged dark red dragon wings and dark torn cape. Clean detailed 2D painted RPG battle artwork, consistent anatomy, NOT chibi. Output EXACTLY a 4-column by 3-row grid of twelve equally sized frames, all on a genuinely transparent background, no background scenery, no panels, no text, no numbers, no grid lines. Each frame is a fully visible entire character including both wings, boots and sword, with generous transparent margins; consistent scale and feet baseline in every cell, facing screen left in three-quarter view. First row is four consecutive melee action poses: neutral guarded standing, lifting sword back with weight shift, strong diagonal forward slash at maximum extension, settled follow-through. Second row four consecutive casting poses: braced stance with sword lowered, left hand gathering chest crimson flame, arm extended launching dragon fire with wings stretched, recovering to guarded stance. Third row four sequential reactions: steady wing-open power stance, recoiling from a blow, one knee buckling with wings down, collapsed defeated knight with sword at side. Sharp unblurred silhouettes, maintain both hands natural and articulated, sword a single rigid straight object, no lens flares and no attack trail obscuring character. Keep all twelve cells nonoverlapping and all weapons and wings inside their cell. This is a transparent character motion atlas, not an illustration montage.

assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Remake this exact 12-frame knight sprite atlas with STRICTLY separated equal rectangular cells in a 4 columns x 3 rows grid. Each entire character must fit within the CENTRAL 68% of its own cell with at least 16% transparent margins on all four sides. Reduce characters to fit, do NOT crop swords or wings. No sword or glow can cross a cell boundary. The original atlas has overlapping swords and clipped edges: fix those only. Preserve the black horned dragon knight identity, armor, wings, sword and twelve ordered poses: row1 idle/windup/slash/follow-through; row2 brace/gather/dragonfire cast/recover; row3 wings spread/hit/kneel/collapse. Characters all face left, cast to LEFT. Same foot baseline per row and same body scale. All artwork is fully within each of the twelve separated cells, transparent gaps. True transparent background. No text, labels, lines or boxes. Maintain original detailed painterly fantasy character finish.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production game VFX animation spritesheet for a corrupted dragon knight: an eruption of dark crimson dragon fire carrying black ember fragments, forming a fleeting snarling draconic head as it rolls from right to left and bursts at the target. Exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, twelve sequential frames in reading order, evenly sized cells, genuine transparent background. Frame1 small spark at right, frames2-4 flame unfurls toward left, frames5-8 peak broad fire plume and visible dragon jaw followed by explosive impact, frames9-12 dark embers and red smoke dissipate. Each effect fully fits within central 76% of its cell, transparent gutters; consistent fixed origin and camera, no panels/gridlines/text/characters/weapons/ground. Detailed painted high-end RPG flame textures with sharp cores, layered smoke and embers. No solid rectangles, no generic circles. All twelve frames of ONE animation.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production game VFX animation atlas for a corrupted dragon knight oath: twin suspended faceted crimson heart crystals bound by blackened gold thorn chains; chains fracture and crystals rupture outward into sharp red shards and smoky ash. Exactly 4 columns by 3 rows with twelve sequential frames in reading order. Real transparency; all effects completely inside CENTRAL 76% of equal cells leaving empty transparent gutters. Frame1 faint crystal embers, frames2-4 both hearts emerge and chains tighten, frames5-6 scarlet charged crack, frames7-8 paired rupture and broken chain shards, frames9-12 embers and wispy violet ash fade out. Fixed center and scale, no camera shifts. Refined dark fantasy RPG painted effects, no background, text, grid, panels, characters or flat vector circles. This is one coherent animation.

Use case: stylized-concept. A production game VFX spritesheet of a black dragon knight's greatsword slash and its bone-white sanctuary interception. Exactly 4 columns x 3 rows of twelve sequential frames left-to-right, top-to-bottom on genuine transparency. Cells all identical and each complete effect fits CENTRAL 76% with transparent gutters. Frames1-3 a sharp narrow diagonal crimson slash gathers, frames4-6 thick black-red crescent sword shockwave descends, frames7-8 hits an ornate translucent ivory dragon-bone ward and throws sparks, frames9-12 ward cracks, slash fades to floating ember fragments. No characters, no swords, no scenery, no text, no grid lines, no opaque rectangle. Premium painted RPG materials and layered glowing edge detail, not a simple geometric circle. Consistent camera and central contact point.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the attached 1536x1024 original Blackwing raid boss illustration. This is a VERY LOCAL sword-hilt cleanup, not a redraw or redesign.
User request: the sword handle behind the hands is bent; shorten it so that protruding rear handle disappears.
Remove ONLY the exposed wrapped rear grip and spiked pommel sticking out to the viewer's RIGHT beyond the rear/rightmost armored gripping hand (roughly x=1095–1230, y=385–452 in the 1536x1024 image). End the hilt immediately at the outer edge of that hand with at most a tiny flush plain end-cap. No shaft, long grip, spike, or pommel may protrude to the right of the hand. Reconstruct the small underlying dark armor/cape area naturally.
Preserve exactly: both gauntlets and their current grip/position, the blade and ornate crossguard extending down-left, straight blade direction, face/helmet/horns, all armor, chest glow, wings, legs, ruins, sky, lighting, composition, crop and original 1536x1024 aspect ratio. Keep the existing detailed dark fantasy painting style. No text, no extra objects. Everything outside the tiny rear-hilt area should look unchanged.
